$comment: coldpress-os enforcement hooks (action plan §4.4, WS1). Each event is wired to a thin dep-free wrapper under scripts/hooks/ that forwards to `coldpress hook <name>`; the logic lives in @coldpress/core and is unit-tested. Hooks honor COLDPRESS_OVERRIDE="<gate>:<reason>" (loudly logged) and support `coldpress hook <name> --explain`. More hooks (sacred-guard, phase-gate, schema-validate, secret-scan, quality-gate, run-log) land as WS1 progresses.
